scope: Managed YCloud account verification and persistent local text permissions; APIs and Settings controls; legacy contracts preserved

implementation.verification: Provider GET checks reuse the bounded YCloud verifier with exact managed connection callback. Source read and save recheck active admin; private ciphertext is decrypted only on server. Client supplies endpoint ID only; callback derives from CHANNEL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
implementation.identity: SHA256 source fingerprint binds workspace/connection/provider/account/ciphertext/key-version/credential-expiry, independent of status/capabilities. Existing ingress sourceRevision still fences lifecycle changes. Late/equal-time proof cannot replace newer proof
implementation.storage: Two private RLS tables, no browser grants; service-only INVOKER RPCs, empty search_path. Saving proof grants no capability and changes no status
implementation.permission: Explicit admin confirmation; exact stable callback, complete current provider proof and same-account accepted outbox/job/message plus delivered/read receipt required. Maximum verification+24h, capped by credential expiry. No opt-in, rollout, AI or campaign activation
implementation.replay: Operation UUID pinned to actor/workspace/connection/action; same operation returns current state without reapplying after revoke; revision/verification changes rejected with23514
implementation.invalidation: Credential rotation/expiry or failed/deleted proof removes owned capability. Final channel_text_grant_until SQL boundary also checks managed source/proof/receipt freshness. Legacy/unowned capability behavior preserved
implementation.providers: YCloud verification/text permission supported for managed accounts; Kapso review includes unsupported_provider and cannot grant through these APIs
implementation.ui: Per-account review, exact server callback, provider check, blockers, explicit text checkbox, grant/revoke and uncertainty/retry retaining the same operation UUID. Read requests parallel, stale reads ignored. Does not auto-check providers on render

tests.lint: pass for changed TS/TSX and new MJS probes
tests.reactReview: React Best Practices; parallel reads, lazy explicit provider checks, useId labels, native checkbox, no secret props; stale read revision and same-operation retry guards
tests.staticRender: Actual component rendered with React DOM server and local TypeScript JSX loader; initial review control present, no credentials. Not an interactive/responsive test
tests.cloud: Same PostgreSQL17.11 proof/grant/revoke/replay probe passes locally and Cloud under service_role with rollback
tests.httpProofLimit: Positive permission HTTP test used explicitly synthetic SQL proof/accepted job/outbox/message/receipt in a disposable workspace. No live provider verification/delivery occurred; provider GET response checking is mocked in unit tests
tests.build: Not repeated; full suites, typecheck/lint, SQL and real authenticated HTTP used
tests.browser: No browser actions or policy workaround. Previous localhost/settings inspection denial remains; interactive/responsive review pending

cloud.cleanup: Scoped guarded cleanup removed disposable workspace00000000-0000-4000-9000-000000003201 and every proof, permission, private credential, receipt, message, accepted fixture job/outbox, conversation, identity/contact and audit. Original QA user/memberships preserved
